decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets in the allowed context [555,639]: (1) a major 3D discontinuity centered ~594–596 with sustained N/E/U deviation and incomplete recovery by index 603; (2) a secondary U drop with concurrent N/E rise at ~625–626, lacking clear return. Neither shows a confirmed opposing return on all affected axes within the allowed window; both are classified as uncertain.

intervals.observation: N: sharp upward step ~594–596, sustained elevated level through 603; E: upward step ~595–597, then gradual decline but not back to pre-event level by 603; U: large negative step ~594–596, followed by slow partial recovery (still ~−12 MAD at 603). Return not observed on any axis before end of allowed context. Cross-axis coherence supports a single 3D offset event, but absence of full return makes status uncertain.

U: second sharp drop ~625–626 (coincident with optional jump at 625), N and E rise concurrently (~625–627); however, N/E do not show a clear opposing return before 628, and U remains depressed. No sustained platform or clean reversal observed; motion appears ongoing or unresolved. Status uncertain due to ambiguous recovery and overlapping with prior offset tail.
